question: Do re-sampling (SMOTE), re-weighting, threshold moving and adversarial debiasing improve failure detection under 3.4 % failures, and do they narrow the gap in recall and false-positive rate between machine Types L, M and H?

data.group_attribute: machine Type (L/M/H), a product-quality variant; not a protected human attribute

adversarial.paper: Zhang, Lemoine & Mitchell (2018), equality-of-odds adversary, projection update
adversarial.rule: smallest mean validation (recall gap + FPR gap) at threshold 0.5 among alphas whose mean validation cost is at most 10% above the adversary-off model's; chosen before test is read

parity_screen_d1.why: D1's delivery-history generator reads supplier terms and weekly sales from the PostgreSQL workspace (tenant_session); this study was kept database-free, so the supplier screen was not run

sources: Matzka, S. (2020). AI4I 2020 Predictive Maintenance Dataset. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C5HS5C
Chawla, N. V., Bowyer, K. W., Hall, L. O., Kegelmeyer, W. P. (2002). SMOTE: Synthetic Minority Over-sampling Technique. JAIR 16, 321-357
Kamiran, F., Calders, T. (2012). Data preprocessing techniques for classification without discrimination. Knowledge and Information Systems 33, 1-33
Zhang, B. H., Lemoine, B., Mitchell, M. (2018). Mitigating Unwanted Biases with Adversarial Learning. AIES 2018
limits: AI4I 2020 is itself synthetic (modelled on a real milling process), not observed failures

Type is a product-quality variant, not a protected human attribute: it demonstrates the method only. In the generator, failure mechanics differ by Type (the overstrain limit and tool-wear increment depend on it), so equal error rates across Types are not a requirement here

one fixed split (PM1's, seed 6); 71 test failures; type H has 7 test failures, so its recall moves 14 points per failure and dominates the three-group recall gap (Wilson 95 % intervals per group are given)
recall_gap_groups_with_10_failures leaves out Types with fewer than 10 test failures
costs are PM1's ASSUMED values; cost_gbp is the realised cost on the test split under them
methods 1-4 alert at p >= 0.5; '+threshold' and threshold_moving use PM1's cost threshold chosen on validation
SMOTE rows are interpolated machines and may be physically implausible; derived features are recomputed

adversarial: a linear predictor trained full-batch with class weights in PyTorch; its sd over 5 seeds reflects only the initial weights of predictor and adversary, not resampling of data (with the adversary off the predictor converges to the scikit-learn class-weighted model, so its sd is near zero)
the Type probe is linear in the predictor's logit and the label; a richer probe might find more
the D1 supplier parity screen was not run (needs the database)
